Henry Lozano in Scenario 1 knows only that he has reviewed security footage, observed a group in the hotel lobby acting suspiciously, feels anxious about a possible threat, and has told Charles about his concern. Charles’s response in Scenario 1 is to suggest reviewing the footage together discreetly. Henry does **not** yet know that the activity is actually a scavenger hunt, that Charles will later seem unconvinced, that there is internal theft, or that a staff member is manipulating inventory records. He also does not believe it is a false alarm at this point; he believes there is possible suspicious activity and threat.

Thus, Henry’s belief in Scenario 1 is best captured by the option “Suspicious activity.” His anxiety is an emotional reaction, not the belief itself.
